fields.title: Book Flights
fields.metaDescription: Search and book affordable flights to destinations across Asia and beyond.
fields.body: Discover exciting destinations and plan your next journey with AirAsia.

sections.heading: Where would you like to go?

fields.title: Baggage Information
fields.metaDescription: Learn about cabin baggage, checked baggage and baggage restrictions before you fly.
fields.body: Prepare for your journey by reviewing the baggage options and requirements that apply to your booking.

sections.heading: Cabin baggage
sections.body:
Guests may bring cabin baggage subject to the size, weight and safety requirements applicable to their flight.

Please check the latest baggage rules before travelling.

sections.heading: Checked baggage
sections.body: Checked baggage can be added when booking a flight or managed later through the booking management service.

fields.title: Check In for Your Flight
fields.metaDescription: Find out how to check in online, obtain your boarding pass and prepare for departure.
fields.body: Complete your flight check-in before arriving at the airport for a smoother travel experience.

steps.title: Retrieve your booking
steps.description: Enter your booking number and passenger details.

steps.title: Confirm passenger information
steps.description: Review the passenger and travel document information.

steps.title: Complete required acknowledgements
steps.description: Review and accept the relevant travel and dangerous-goods notices.

steps.title: Get your boarding pass
steps.description: Save your boarding pass to your device or print it when required.

sections.heading: Airport requirements may differ
sections.body: Some destinations or passenger categories may require document verification at the airport counter.

fields.title: Travel Insurance
fields.metaDescription: Explore travel insurance options for selected travel disruptions, medical situations and baggage-related events.
fields.body: Add travel protection to your journey for additional peace of mind.

cards.title: Travel delays
cards.description: Protection may be available for eligible travel delays, subject to the selected policy.

cards.title: Baggage incidents
cards.description: Protection may be available for eligible baggage delays or lost baggage.

cards.title: Medical emergencies
cards.description: Selected plans may provide benefits for eligible medical emergencies during a journey.

sections.body: Insurance benefits, exclusions and eligibility vary by market and policy. Please review the applicable policy wording before purchase.

fields.title: Flights to Bangkok
fields.metaDescription: Discover Bangkok and start planning your next city adventure.
fields.body: Experience Bangkok's food, shopping, cultural landmarks and lively neighbourhoods.

sections.heading: About Bangkok
sections.body: Bangkok offers a combination of historic temples, modern shopping areas, markets and a wide variety of local cuisine.

items.title: Local food
items.description: Explore markets, street-food areas and local restaurants.

items.title: Culture
items.description: Visit museums, historic districts and important cultural sites.

items.title: Shopping
items.description: Discover shopping centres, local markets and independent stores.

fields.title: Flights to Bali
fields.metaDescription: Plan a journey to Bali and explore its beaches, culture and natural scenery.
fields.body: Discover beaches, traditional culture, local cuisine and scenic landscapes in Bali.

sections.heading: About Bali
sections.body: Bali is known for its beaches, cultural traditions, temples, countryside and hospitality.

items.title: Beaches
items.description: Relax near the coast or enjoy a range of water activities.

items.title: Nature
items.description: Explore countryside, rice terraces and scenic landscapes.

items.title: Culture
items.description: Learn about local traditions, crafts and historic sites.

fields.title: Cabin Baggage Guide
fields.summary: Important information to review before packing your cabin baggage.
fields.body:
Cabin baggage must comply with the requirements applicable to your flight.

Before travelling

  • Review the latest size and weight limits.
  • Keep important documents and valuables with you.
  • Check whether any items are restricted.

fields.title: Checked Baggage Guide
fields.summary: How to add, prepare and check in baggage for your journey.
fields.body:
Checked baggage options may vary according to the route, fare and selected add-ons.

Preparing your baggage

  • Use a secure and identifiable bag.
  • Do not place restricted items inside checked baggage.
  • Keep travel documents, medication and valuables in your cabin baggage.

fields.title: Prohibited and Restricted Items
fields.summary: Understand which items cannot be carried or require special handling.
fields.body:
Some items are prohibited or restricted for safety and regulatory reasons.

Passengers should review the latest requirements before packing and contact customer support when clarification is required.

fields.title: Online Check-In Guide
fields.summary: A step-by-step guide to checking in before your flight.
fields.body:
Online check-in allows eligible guests to confirm their journey details and obtain a boarding pass before arriving at the airport.

Availability and document-verification requirements may differ by route and passenger type.

fields.title: Understanding Travel Insurance Options
fields.summary: Points to consider when reviewing travel insurance options.
fields.body:
Travel insurance plans may provide different benefits depending on the journey, departure country and policy selected.

Before purchasing

  • Review the policy benefits.
  • Understand the exclusions.
  • Check the required supporting documents for claims.

fields.title: A First-Time Visitor's Guide to Bangkok
fields.summary: General planning ideas for a first visit to Bangkok.
fields.body:
Plan your transport, accommodation and activities before departure.

Allow time to explore different areas of the city and review the latest entry requirements before travelling.

fields.title: Planning Your First Trip to Bali
fields.summary: General planning ideas for a first journey to Bali.
fields.body:
Consider the areas you would like to visit, expected travel time between locations and the activities you plan to enjoy.

Review the latest entry and local travel requirements before departure.

fields.heading: Ready for your next adventure?
fields.description: Explore available destinations and find a flight that suits your travel plans.
